entities.summary: The Awami National Party (ANP) is a Pakistani political party primarily based in the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. A leftist Pashtun nationalist party which advocates for federalism in Pakistan, its president is Aimal Wali Khan since 2024 with Mian Iftikhar Hussain serving as the secretary-general. Awami National Party is a political party in Peshawar, established in 1986. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
